summary_en: PQ203, a peptide drug-conjugate, is being tested in people with advanced solid tumors, including triple negative breast cancer. It is given by intravenous infusion once weekly; how long treatment continues is not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, and it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: PQ203, un conjugado peptídico de fármaco, se está probando en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de mama triple negativo. Se administra por infusión intravenosa una vez por semana; no se indica por cuánto tiempo continúa el tratamiento. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Metastatic or locally advanced solid tumor that has progressed on standard therapy or is otherwise ineligible for it.
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1.
Adequate blood, liver, kidney and heart function based on lab tests within 14 days of the first dose.
not_for: Prior receipt of an MMAE-containing drug or a SORT1-targeting medication.
History of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or current or suspected lung inflammation that cannot be ruled out.
Known or suspected pregnancy or lactation, or weight above 115 kg.
